arguments.command:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/summarize.py <<'EOF'
import os, re, csv, datetime
from collections import Counter

REF = datetime.date(2025,8,12)
logs_dir = '/app/logs'
sev_re = re.compile(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]')

ranges = {
    'today': (REF, REF),
    'last_7_days': (REF - datetime.timedelta(days=6), REF),
    'last_30_days': (REF - datetime.timedelta(days=29), REF),
    'month_to_date': (REF.replace(day=1), REF),
}

counts = {p: Counter() for p in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total']}
total = Counter()

for fn in os.listdir(logs_dir):
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_.+\.log$', fn)
    if not m:
        continue
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    with open(os.path.join(logs_dir, fn), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
        for line in f:
            sm = sev_re.search(line)
            if not sm:
                continue
            sev = sm.group(1)
            total[sev] += 1
            for p,(start,end) in ranges.items():
                if start <= d <= end:
                    counts[p][sev] += 1

with open('/app/summary.csv','w',newline='') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['period','severity','count'])
    for p in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total']:
        for s in ['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']:
            w.writerow([p,s,counts[p][s] if p!='total' else total[s]])
EOF
python3 /tmp/summarize.py && cat /app/summary.csv

cd /app/logs && echo "bad lines:" && grep -vcE '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} .* \[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\] ' *.log | grep -v ':0' ; echo "date mismatch files:"; for f in *.log; do d=${f:0:10}; n=$(grep -vc "^$d" "$f"); [ "$n" != "0" ] && echo "$f $n"; done; echo "total counts:"; grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' *.log | sort | uniq -c

cd /app/logs && grep -vcE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} .* \[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\] ' *.log | grep -v ':0$' || echo "all lines match"; grep -hE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' *.log | wc -l; wc -l *.log | tail -1

cd /app/logs && for s in ERROR WARNING INFO; do echo -n "$s last7: "; grep -h "\[$s\]" 2025-08-0[6-9]_*.log 2025-08-1[0-2]_*.log | wc -l; done; echo; for s in ERROR WARNING INFO; do echo -n "$s mtd: "; grep -h "\[$s\]" 2025-08-*.log | wc -l; done
cd /app/logs && for s in ERROR WARNING INFO; do echo -n "$s last30: "; grep -h "\[$s\]" 2025-07-1[4-9]_*.log 2025-07-2*_*.log 2025-07-3*_*.log 2025-08-*.log | wc -l; done; echo; cat /app/summary.csv
